designSummary: GRAD11. User-cleaned original destination, authorized 2026-10-22. Four-zone Layer0 composition using the exact Rocky/Techno/Crystal sprites shown in the inspected asset boards, plus connected industrial modules. World dimensions are derived from catalog dimensions, not assumed PPU. REACTOR DELIVERY PENDING: one 14x14 static ring/mount placeholder at KM176; replace with the delivered complete animated visual assembly after import/catalog intake. Layout preparation only; not imported, built or visually accepted. Full player bounds remain 51.36 units high; camera viewport is 27 units high and cannot show the entire movement arena at once. Added four catalog-backed Tentacle prefabs, two in factory, one in crystals, one in reactor. The existing 16/12/8-frame reactor animation controller is verified but no catalog-eligible animated prefab assembly exists yet: retains explicit static ring and mounts as placeholders. User-cleaned original GRAD11 has HandoffComplete=true; do NOT bypass. PRE-BUILD ONLY until supported same-scene handoff and refreshed catalog/context. Reactor_2026_CoreVisual.prefab created in Unity 2026-10-22 with controller and SpriteRenderer; it is NOT in this JSON until a fresh catalog export verifies eligibility. Native Unity post-handoff placement required, never substitute invalid assetId.
